description: I want a better world for my children. When my 8 year old realizes that some political figures are saying and acting in a way we would never allow our children, I want to ensure she doesn’t continue to see these figures in power. That’s why I believe in Robyn Vining because I know she’s someone who my daughter could look up to as a role model who thinks for the people.

title: Sarah | Robyn For WI
